description: A component that calls `createResource` must not read it. The declaration lives in one component body and every read of the data signal lives in a child, wrapped in `Suspense`. A signal filled in by an effect that only loads something is a resource written out longhand. Applies whenever adding a resource to a component, writing a new component that reads one, or writing an effect that loads.
